content.en:
Thank you for using Orinav! This release brings new features and bug fixes to help you discover new places and navigate to them.
- Improved navigation user interface with larger cards.
- Incorporated built-in voice search.
content.zh-Hans:
感谢您使用奥里导航! 本次更新带来的新功能及问题修复有助于您探索新地点并更好地出行。
- 使用更大的卡片改善导航用户界面。
- 加入内置语音搜索。
